web.title: Website
web.why: The server logs count every page load by a person (bots are counted separately), including people who block cookies or ads. GA4 counts only visitors who accepted cookies and whose browser does not block Google Analytics, so it is always lower. Log "visitors" is an estimate: distinct network + browser pairs per day, counted in memory only and stored as a number.
web.ga4_note: GA4 counts only visitors who accepted cookies and do not block Google Analytics.

api.title: App and website usage (API requests)
api.note: The platform comes from the client type: Android (okhttp), iPhone (CFNetwork) and the website (a browser coming from an XXL site). Only requests are counted, not users or devices: the app sends no identifier, and that stays so.
